text.tspan: dKₗ/dt = 4πR²Ṙ · ρ(RR̈ + 3Ṙ²/2) = V̇_b × (inertial pressure). Formula and finite difference agree to 0.00 % of the peak.
The same V̇_b = 4πR²Ṙ multiplies every term: volume work is what couples kinetic storage, interface storage and dissipation.
Rayleigh–Plesset solution (R₀ = 5 µm, p_g0 = 1 MPa, γ = 1.4, σ = 0.072 N/m, μ = 1 mPa·s) differentiated with the product rule of Eq. C1-E10.
